user_direction: Retain the previously used H2O30K prescription for the bounded four-model silicate comparison; a new full-range table is not a launch prerequisite.
extension_method: No extended input table is created. Use the running MCFOST executable's native optical-constant treatment outside the tabulated range; runtime binds the executable hash. No independently verified version-specific extrapolation law is asserted here.
join_description: No splice or new join. Keep all 3000 samples over 0.25004000002-19.940540101 um byte-for-byte unchanged.
tail_temperature_assumptions: The 30 K label applies to the supplied laboratory constants, not to unmeasured extrapolated tails or to the computed source temperature. Fresh radiative equilibrium is conditional on the native extrapolation assumption; tail sensitivity is not certified.
prior_temperature_caveat: The completed archived supplied-H2O cases reused the original-dust temperature field. Their success does not validate a fresh-temperature calculation with this material.
known_other_prescription_failure: The supplied laboratory-silicate package records olivine plus H2O30K coated-Mie initialization failing with SIGSEGV. That is a different prescription from this Draine/separate-DHS pilot; cause and applicability are not established.
